inputs.name: the signatures of the Cells that carry [ORG]HOAC-GOV and [ORG]HOAC-TM: the installation and every change of the Charter, gateway policy, the engine register and every listed type
inputs.format: signature record at the tool gateway (Protocol §4.9)

inputs.name: every tool and engine call of every part of the organisation
inputs.format: gateway request (caller's Cell code, decision type, payload hash), received at the tool gateway

inputs.name: every record write and every number request of every part
inputs.format: event with its time-sortable ID, the writer's Cell code and the expected revision; number request naming its record type and entity

inputs.name: every Work Item of every part
inputs.format: Work Item (spec/schemas/work-item.schema.json), written by its one owner

inputs.name: a part's installation: its record types and its routing rows
inputs.format: registry entries and routing rows, signed with the installation

outputs.name: for every call: allowed, refused or held, with its reason, and the engine bound and the engine that served
outputs.format: append-only gateway log entry (payload hash, Cell codes, pseudonymous identity references only)

outputs.name: readable numbers, one stream per record type (and per entity where the type is kept per entity), never repeated and never skipped
outputs.format: number issued by the numbering service, idempotent on the request ID

outputs.name: every part's record home, and the projections rebuilt from it
outputs.format: append-only events; projections carrying the version of their logic

outputs.name: the daily check's findings: projections that differ from a rebuild, number gaps or duplicates, acts not attributed, figures that do not trace
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) to the part concerned and its accountable seat

outputs.name: Work Items routed, and items past their waiting time raised
outputs.format: Work Item status change, and a watchdog raise to the seat §4.6 names

outputs.name: wake signals to each part's runtime

tool_roles: tool gateway, with its signature check, engine register and log
live sign-in for the HU ports
shared Work Item queue, with its watchdog
